layouts.hero_view: Southwest entry-arch corner, camera 50 inches high, looking northeast: flax sofa, curved walnut coffee table, two open timber chairs and mantel artwork; no TV on hearth.
removes: all existing movable furniture; no gym, cat furniture, desk or owner seating retained

other.tv_note: Three sofa seats face broadly south toward TV on southeast console; exact screen yaw should be set from seated trial. No over-mantel heat or lookup issue. 43-inch screen modest at approximately 10-foot distance.

window_reach_in.south_picture_fixed: fixed; clear from chair backs to south wall42 inches (quality),44.5(value)

other.drawer_and_door_access: TV cabinet faces north after geometry correction below; keep a 24-inch service strip in front. No movable chair on cabinet door path.
other.doors: No hinged room door swings into living room; front door swings outside footprint in vestibule.
other.flush_hearth_policy: Walkable low/near-flush hearth per brief; no furniture or rug placed on it. Operating route uses it only if verified safely flush.

geometry_script.method: Python: nominal room bounds, pairwise exact AABB checks; 0.25-degree swept thin door rectangles tested by separating-axis theorem; .5-inch-grid widest disk path for routes. Door states separate. No generic unverified footprint substituted for a purchasable product.
geometry_script.exclusions: Rug under furniture, mattress on bed, wall art, curtains behind furniture and lamp atop nightstand are intentional vertical layers. Nook tabletop above seat is allowed; base is checked separately.

rental_checks.notes: Five seats = sleeping count plus one. One guest-bedroom desk serves MTR; dining table is second occasional work surface. No sleeper raises the advertised occupancy. All original furniture/cat posts leave; only fixed fireplace, fan and windows remain. Functional TV display is not glass furniture.
rental_checks.glass_policy_interpretation: No glass furniture, lamp shades, vessels or picture glazing. Required functional safety-backed wall mirrors and TV display are not mirrored furniture; neither is freestanding/leaning. Obtain owner clarification if literal no-glass includes required functional mirror.

layouts.rationale: Reese is used in both tiers because verified 102,000 Wyzenbeek/SW fabric is a better rental saving than an undocumented bargain sofa. Quality buys Vermont solid-walnut sculptural chairs; value substitutes wipeable pale-oak bentwood and a lower-cost closed cabinet.

layouts.hero_view: From southwest entry arch at 50 inches, looking northeast: camel sofa, ink stripe, clay rug and clear fireplace. Second view south shows low side-wall TV.
layouts.rationale: Cognac becomes Sumner camel performance weave, not spill-sensitive aniline leather. Spend on the same verified sofa in both tiers; save on tables and lighting. Two lightweight wood chairs avoid unverified upholstery.
removes: All existing movable furniture; no reuse assumed.

hand_checks.method: Executable Python rectangle/SAT audit against exact room JSON; quarter-degree one-sided door-leaf sweeps; explicit analytic corridor/ellipse calculations. Survey, not tape-verified.

other.door_swing: No room door swings here; vestibule door stays outside room.

rental_checks.hard_rules: conditional: geometry passes nominal calibrated minima; unresolved hardware/installation conditions below prevent unconditional procurement approval
rental_checks.notes: Five seats, not six; both wood chairs are for conversation and need to turn manually for TV. Curtains near fireplace require heat-clearance review; fireplace stays OFF until that is done. South-window side approach is tighter than24in; direct approach from east avoids the cabinet. Exact sofa rental-use warranty remains unverified despite fabric102000 Wyzenbeek/SW evidence.
rental_checks.fabric_policy: No velvet, bouclé, white seating, glass-top or marble furniture. Functional safety-backed wall mirrors and electronic displays are not mirrored furniture. Removable bedding and shade fabric are not seat upholstery.

layouts.hero_view: From southwest entry arch at 50 inches, looking northeast: camel sofa, ink stripe, clay rug and clear fireplace. Second view south shows low side-wall TV.
layouts.rationale: Cognac becomes Sumner camel performance weave, not spill-sensitive aniline leather. Spend on the same verified sofa in both tiers; save on tables and lighting. Two lightweight wood chairs avoid unverified upholstery.
removes: All existing movable furniture; no reuse assumed.

hand_checks.method: Executable Python rectangle/SAT audit against exact room JSON; quarter-degree one-sided door-leaf sweeps; explicit analytic corridor/ellipse calculations. Survey, not tape-verified.

other.door_swing: No room door swings here; vestibule door stays outside room.

rental_checks.hard_rules: conditional: geometry passes nominal calibrated minima; unresolved hardware/installation conditions below prevent unconditional procurement approval
rental_checks.notes: Five seats, not six; both wood chairs are for conversation and need to turn manually for TV. Curtains near fireplace require heat-clearance review; fireplace stays OFF until that is done. South-window side approach is tighter than24in; direct approach from east avoids the cabinet. Exact sofa rental-use warranty remains unverified despite fabric102000 Wyzenbeek/SW evidence.
rental_checks.fabric_policy: No velvet, bouclé, white seating, glass-top or marble furniture. Functional safety-backed wall mirrors and electronic displays are not mirrored furniture. Removable bedding and shade fabric are not seat upholstery.

removes: all existing movable furniture; no gym, cat furniture, desk or owner seating retained

other.tv_note: Three sofa seats face broadly south toward TV on southeast console; exact screen yaw should be set from seated trial. No over-mantel heat or lookup issue. 43-inch screen modest at approximately 10-foot distance.

window_reach_in.south_picture_fixed: fixed; clear from chair backs to south wall42 inches (quality),44.5(value)

other.drawer_and_door_access: TV cabinet faces north after geometry correction below; keep a 24-inch service strip in front. No movable chair on cabinet door path.
other.doors: No hinged room door swings into living room; front door swings outside footprint in vestibule.
other.flush_hearth_policy: Walkable low/near-flush hearth per brief; no furniture or rug placed on it. Operating route uses it only if verified safely flush.

geometry_script.method: Python: nominal room bounds, pairwise exact AABB checks; 0.25-degree swept thin door rectangles tested by separating-axis theorem; .5-inch-grid widest disk path for routes. Door states separate. No generic unverified footprint substituted for a purchasable product.
geometry_script.exclusions: Rug under furniture, mattress on bed, wall art, curtains behind furniture and lamp atop nightstand are intentional vertical layers. Nook tabletop above seat is allowed; base is checked separately.

rental_checks.notes: Five seats = sleeping count plus one. One guest-bedroom desk serves MTR; dining table is second occasional work surface. No sleeper raises the advertised occupancy. All original furniture/cat posts leave; only fixed fireplace, fan and windows remain. Functional TV display is not glass furniture.
rental_checks.glass_policy_interpretation: No glass furniture, lamp shades, vessels or picture glazing. Required functional safety-backed wall mirrors and TV display are not mirrored furniture; neither is freestanding/leaning. Obtain owner clarification if literal no-glass includes required functional mirror.

layouts.rationale: Reese is used in both tiers because verified 102,000 Wyzenbeek/SW fabric is a better rental saving than an undocumented bargain sofa. Quality buys Vermont solid-walnut sculptural chairs; value substitutes wipeable pale-oak bentwood and a lower-cost closed cabinet.
